# Wenboom — AI Infrastructure Benchmarks & Architecture Registry (2026)
> Production-tested blueprints, cost benchmarks, and failure protocols for enterprise AI automation. Authored by Alex, Principal AI Infrastructure Architect.

## 1. n8n Architecture & High-Concurrency Scaling
- [n8n Queue Mode Docker Setup](https://wenboom.com/trends/n8n-queue-mode-docker-compose-redis): Full docker-compose with Redis, worker scaling, and encryption key migration.
- [n8n Webhook Response Relay Size Fix](https://wenboom.com/trends/n8n-webhook-response-relay-size-fix): 64MB buffer limit resolution and memory overflow prevention.
- [n8n Postgres vs SQLite Queue Benchmark](https://wenboom.com/trends/n8n-postgres-vs-sqlite-queue-mode-benchmark): IOPS limits and index tuning for 1M+ executions.
- [n8n vs Temporal vs Windmill 2026](https://wenboom.com/trends/n8n-vs-temporal-vs-windmill-orchestration): Developer-perspective comparison of three orchestration engines.

## 2. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Security & Implementation
